latest_release.name: decap-cms@3.17.3
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(widget-file): download unsaved media instead of opening it by @martinjagodic in https://github.com/decaporg/decap-cms/commit/9e1e68aef ([GHSA-qf66-gqh8-qvrh](https://github.com/decaporg/decap-cms/security/advisories/GHSA-qf66-gqh8-qvrh))
* chore(deps): refresh newly flagged lockfile entries by @martinjagodic in https://github.com/decaporg/decap-cms/pull/8051
* fix(widget-code): size markdown code blocks to their content by @rodchristiansen in https://github.com/decaporg/decap-cms/pull/8017
* chore(media-library-s3): describe providers generically by @martinjagodic in https://github.com/decaporg/decap-cms/commit/653c1a6fb
* chore: integration branch for 3.17.3 (do not squash) by @martinjagodic in https://github.com/decaporg/decap-cms/pull/8052

## New Contributors
* @rodchristiansen made their first contribution in https://github.com/decaporg/decap-cms/pull/8017

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/decaporg/decap-cms/compare/decap-cms@3.17.2...decap-cms@3.17.3
